svg.title: Muhammad Awais | Operations Manager
svg.desc: A terminal-inspired profile banner in Pakistani green and sky blue. It types out Muhammad Awais as Operations Manager at AI GenMat, his Software Engineering degree at FAST-NUCES Islamabad, and his AI GenMat experience timeline.
